newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Dumai pays 100 rupiah dividend for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Dumai pays 100 rupiah dividend for 1996.

text.p: Indonesia's timber firm PT Surya Dumai Industri said in a statement on Tuesday it would pay a dividend of 100 rupiah per share for 1996.
Dumai did not give details on dividend payment for 1995 as the firm went public only in July 1996.
Dumai said its shareholders also approved the firm's proposed additional investment in subsidiary timber firm PT Perawang Lumber Industri.
Perawang would used the 88.6 billion rupiah investment for business expansion, Dumai said.
Dumai said it would use some 13.8 billion rupiah from its initial public offering proceeds to finance the investment.
The statement did not give further details.
